, and raises on markup that does not parse; without a host layer ree has no rich-text parser, measures the text as written and reports it missing

text_bounds.line: a family that is no file: error Temp read failed.
text_bounds.why: a family file a client does not have: it raises reading it; ree cannot know which family files a client has, measures it as SourceSans and reports it missing

value_read_identity.why: a client makes a new userdata for each read of a property holding a datatype other than Vector3 (Color3, CFrame, UDim2, Vector2, UDim, Rect, NumberRange, the sequences, PhysicalProperties, Ray), so two reads are not rawequal and the second is not found as a table key; ree hands back the value it made while the property is unchanged
